description: A small stack of wooden Jenga blocks sits on the table, with a loose pile of extra blocks farther back near the curtain. Both hands hover around the stack as the right hand places a block onto the top; then the right hand reaches up and right to pick a block from the pile, brings it down, and sets it onto the stack, briefly standing and adjusting it before releasing and reaching back toward the pile while the left hand stays near the stack without touching it.
